package.name: gz_buoyancy
package.description:
Gazebo's Buoyancy system with runtime registration, so a world can restrict which entities float without naming them before they exist. The stock plugin's <enable> list is fixed at load time, which a world shared by many vehicles cannot fill in; this one adds enable and disable services and a model-side plugin that calls them, so a vehicle declares its own displacement links and the world names nobody.
Vendored from gz-sim and intended to go back upstream, so the delta is kept small and additive; see PROVENANCE.md.
